facts: Second-most populous city, after Ho Chi Minh City
worth_knowing: Home to the Imperial Citadel of Thăng Long, the Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum and Hoàn Kiếm Lake. Its architecture mixes pre-colonial Vietnamese, French colonial and brutalist styles.
